title: Wiregrass Museum of Art

services.name: The Art Of Yoga
services.desc: Wednesday evenings from 5:30- 6:30- $10 each, fee is paid to the instructor at the door. The Art of Yoga event at the WMA is a harmonious fusion of artistic expression and mindful movement. Attendees are invited to immerse themselves in a unique experience that combines the tranquility of yoga with the inspiration drawn from the museum’s diverse collection. Against the backdrop of captivating artworks, participants will engage in a rejuvenating yoga session, guided by experienced instructors who seamlessly integrate the principles of mindfulness and creativity. This event aims to celebrate the intersection of art and well-being, offering a holistic and immersive journey for individuals
